'''Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Rosenfeld was born on March 21, 1987, in New York City, New York, and became a voice actress as an adult. She started to provide voices for the {{pkmn|animated series}} during [[S13|the thirteenth season]]. Her first major roles were the [[Nurse Joy]]s of the [[Unova]] [[region]] as well as their {{TP|Nurse Joy|Audino}}. In {{aniseries|XY}}, she received the role of voicing {{an|Bonnie}}, {{an|Clemont}}'s younger sister and one of {{ashfr|Ash's traveling companions}}. In {{aniseries|SM}}, she voiced {{Ash}}'s classmate {{an|Sophocles}}, as well as [[Mallow's Tsareena]]. Rosenfeld is currently affiliated with A3 Artists Agency.

Rosenfeld is married to [[James Weaver Clark]] and currently resides in New York City. On April 28, 2020, Rosenfeld gave birth to a son.
